newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer in catch up with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer in catch up with NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures were traded higher on SIMEX on Friday, catching up with a firm close on NYMEX overnight.
May Brent was traded at $20.35 per barrel, up 17 cents from London's close on Thursday. London fell 14 cents to $20.18, in largely range-bound trading between $20.55 and $20.06.

However, NYMEX crude ended firmer in New York overnight, led by a book squaring rally on the April contract ahead of its expiry on Thursday. April expired at $22.32, for a gain on the day of 28 cents.
May closed up three cents at $21.85 and extended the gains by a further 37 cents on ACCESS.
However, by Asia's midday the rally had cooled to last trade at $21.90, up just five cents.
